problemSigns.detail: Your garage door struggles to move past the same spot each time it opens or closes. This indicates a track obstruction or misalignment.
You can see a bend, dent, or crimp in the vertical or horizontal track sections. This prevents smooth roller movement.
Garage door rollers frequently come out of the track. This is often due to a bent track section or loose brackets.
There is a noticeable gap where the track should be flush with the garage door frame. Loose or damaged track brackets are often the cause.
Unusual grinding or scraping sounds during operation can mean rollers are rubbing against misaligned or damaged tracks.
